# anthropic_spend_limit (Resource)

Manages a per-user spend limit override in a Claude Enterprise organization. Requires `enterprise_api_key` with the spend limit scopes.

The API upserts on `(user_id, period)`: creating a second resource for the same user and period overwrites the first. Only user-scoped limits are writable; seat-tier, group and organization limits are read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cap a user at 500.00 per month (amount is in cents).
resource "anthropic_spend_limit" "alice_monthly" {
  user_id = "user_01ExampleUserId0000000000"
  period  = "monthly"
  amount  = "50000"
}

# Explicitly remove the daily cap for the same user.
resource "anthropic_spend_limit" "alice_daily_uncapped" {
  user_id = "user_01ExampleUserId0000000000"
  period  = "daily"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) User the limit applies to (`user_...`).

### Optional

- `amount` (String) Cap in minor currency units (cents) as a decimal string, e.g. `"50000"` is 500.00. Omit for an explicit no-cap override for this period.
- `period` (String) Budget period: `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`. Defaults to `monthly`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.
- `id` (String) Spend limit id (`spl_...`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_spend_limit.alice_monthly spl_01ExampleSpendLimitId0000
```
